Metadata.title: TimeBridge | Time zone comparison
Metadata.description: Compare local times across cities, convert dates and find overlapping hours for international meetings.

Home.title: Time zone comparison
Home.about: TimeBridge converts the same instant across cities and applies each time zone’s UTC offset on the selected date, including daylight saving time changes.
